_comment: Drop this into your Claude Desktop config (claude_desktop_config.json). It runs sportsdata-mcp via uvx (no install) and enables the AFL public tools. Set SPORTSDATA_MCP_GROUPS to a comma-separated list of groups to expose; run `sportsdata-mcp list-groups` to see them all. For richer config (per-provider rate limits, secrets, premium auth) point SPORTSDATA_MCP_CONFIG at a YAML file instead — see examples/sportsdata-mcp.yaml.
